items.title: Announcing a Course to Help Publishers Navigate the AI Age Responsibly
items.excerpt: Publishing Perspectives is launching a four-week online course and live seminar series to help publishing professionals build practical systems and organizational guidelines around AI usage across the workflow. A workflow/adoption angle for design and publishing orgs figuring out where generative AI fits into editorial, production and marketing craft.

items.title: In Praise of the Translators Who Transport Us Across the Globe
items.excerpt: An argument for literary translation as cultural infrastructure and skilled craft, set against survey data showing translators losing work and income to generative AI. A craft-side counterweight to the industry's rush toward AI-assisted book translation.

items.title: Researchers to Investigate Local Editor and Publisher AI Use
items.excerpt: University of Melbourne and RMIT researchers are surveying editors and publishers about how they actually use generative AI tools in independent publishing practice. A grounded look at where AI is entering real editorial and production workflows, rather than the hype.

items.title: Around the Book World: July 27, 2026
items.excerpt: A weekly international roundup whose AI items include the Hong Kong Book Fair's 'Reading for All in the Age of AI' theme (how AI could reshape reading and critical thinking) and Bloomsbury's share of the $1.5B Anthropic copyright settlement. Lower-value roundup included only because single-story fresh books+AI items were scarce this window; curator may prefer a stronger pick if backfilling from other sections.
